body.label: Effect
body.html: Leave a corrosive elemental wake in a 2-unit line within 4 units. Until your next turn, it is difficult terrain for enemies. The first enemy that enters or begins its turn in the wake becomes Corroded.

surges.html: The first enemy affected by the wake also burns 1 die on its next Action.
If you fully manifest through this Action, the manifestation gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

rider.title: ELEMENTAL — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Elemental.
